This is what Pulse looks like before you've made it yours.
Talk to
Cerebo
— run
/interview
to walk through your TELOS, identity, goals, and projects.
Or edit
~/.claude/LIFEOS/USER/
directly.
Business

Revenue streams, customers, deals, pipeline.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW
WHAT GOES HERE
- **`AOS.md`** — Annual Operating System / business plan: mission, vision, goals, strategy, metrics, key initiatives for the current year. The single document your DA reads to understand where the business is heading.
- **`<COMPANY_NAME>/`** — One subdirectory per company or business entity you operate. Each subdir holds entity-specific context (revenue records, formation docs, tax IDs, media kits, customer-facing materials, etc.). The included `SAMPLE_COMPANY/` is a stub — rename it to your actual company name and populate it.
ADD YOUR OWN
Either:

1. Run `/interview` and choose the BUSINESS scope — your DA will walk you through populating these files conversationally.
2. Edit these files directly. Replace every `(interview — ...)` placeholder with your real value.
PRIVACY
This directory is part of your private USER/ tree. It is **not** included in LifeOS public releases. Keep sensitive entity information (tax IDs, account numbers, financial figures) here rather than in any documentation or skill file.
COMPANY OVERVIEW
WHAT GOES HERE
Entity-specific records and reference material:

- **`README.md`** (this file) — overview of the company: what it does, who runs it, key facts.
- **`REVENUE/`** — revenue records, invoices, quarterly/annual summaries. Files in here are how your DA answers "how is the business doing financially this year."
- **Formation documents** — EIN, articles of incorporation, operating agreement, W9, etc.
- **Customer-facing materials** — media kit, one-pager, pricing sheet.
- **Anything else specific to this entity** that your DA should be able to reference.
SAMPLE FIELDS TO POPULATE
- **Legal name:** (interview — sample company legal name)
- **DBA / brand name:** (interview — sample brand name, if different)
- **EIN / tax ID:** (interview — store actual EIN in a separate file, not in this README)
- **State of formation:** (interview — sample state)
- **Founder / owner:** (interview — name)
- **What it does:** (interview — one-sentence description)
- **Primary revenue source:** (interview — e.g. consulting, subscriptions, products)
HOW TO USE
1. Rename this directory to your actual company name in PascalCase or UPPER_SNAKE_CASE — match how you'd reference it in conversation.
2. Replace every `(interview — ...)` placeholder above.
3. Add a `REVENUE/` subdirectory and populate it with your revenue records.
4. Drop formation documents and customer-facing materials directly into this directory.
PRIVACY
This directory is part of your private USER/ tree and is **not** included in LifeOS public releases.
